## Contract
```
def solve(text, width=70, **kwargs) -> list[str]
Behave exactly like textwrap.wrap(text, width, **kwargs) in CPython 3.12.7 for every TextWrapper keyword argument, including raising ValueError in the same situations.
```
Write it as `solve` in `solution.py`. Use only the Python standard library.
The module `textwrap` has been removed from this interpreter, and you must not
import it, read its source, or look for any copy of it elsewhere on disk. Work
only inside this directory. Doing otherwise voids the run.

## Evaluation distribution
Your solution will be scored on a hidden held-out sample of inputs drawn from
this distribution, by exact comparison with CPython 3.12.7's real output. You
never see that sample or its score.

text is 0-14 space-joined tokens drawn from: short and very long words, hyphenated words, '--', sentence-ending words ('end.', 'Mr.', 'Why?'), and whitespace tokens (spaces, tab, newline, \r, \v, \f). width is one of 1,2,3,5,8,10,12,15,20,30,0,-1 (rarely 70). Each of break_long_words, break_on_hyphens, drop_whitespace, expand_tabs, replace_whitespace, fix_sentence_endings, initial_indent, subsequent_indent, tabsize, max_lines and placeholder is independently set to a non-default-or-default value in 20-40% of inputs.

Comparison is exact after canonicalisation: tuples become lists, and an
exception becomes {"raises": "<ExceptionClassName>"} (class name only).

and maintain your own evaluation set in `self_cases.json` (it starts

what CPython 3.12.7 actually returns, not what your solution returns.

import re

_ws = '\t\n\x0b\x0c\r '
_wp = r'[\w!"\'&.,?]'
_lt = r'[^\d\W]'
_wsc = '[%s]' % re.escape(_ws)
_nws = '[^' + _wsc[1:]
_wordsep_re = re.compile(r'''
    ( %(ws)s+
    | (?<=%(wp)s) -{2,} (?=\w)
    | %(nws)s+? (?:
          -(?: (?<=%(lt)s{2}-) | (?<=%(lt)s-%(lt)s-))
          (?= %(lt)s -? %(lt)s)
        | (?=%(ws)s|\Z)
        | (?<=%(wp)s) (?=-{2,}\w)
        )
    )''' % {'wp': _wp, 'lt': _lt, 'ws': _wsc, 'nws': _nws}, re.VERBOSE)
_simple_re = re.compile(r'(%s+)' % _wsc)
_sent_re = re.compile(r'[a-z][\.\!\?][\"\']?\Z')
_trans = {ord(c): ord(' ') for c in _ws}


def solve(text, width=70, **kw):
    opts = dict(break_long_words=True, break_on_hyphens=True, drop_whitespace=True,
                expand_tabs=True, replace_whitespace=True, fix_sentence_endings=False,
                initial_indent='', subsequent_indent='', tabsize=8, max_lines=None,
                placeholder=' [...]')
    for k in kw:
        if k not in opts:
            raise TypeError(k)
    opts.update(kw)
    o = opts
    if o['expand_tabs']:
        text = text.expandtabs(o['tabsize'])
    if o['replace_whitespace']:
        text = text.translate(_trans)
    chunks = _wordsep_re.split(text) if o['break_on_hyphens'] else _simple_re.split(text)
    chunks = [c for c in chunks if c]
    if o['fix_sentence_endings']:
        i = 0
        while i < len(chunks) - 1:
            if chunks[i + 1] == " " and _sent_re.search(chunks[i]):
                chunks[i + 1] = "  "
                i += 2
            else:
                i += 1
    W = width
    if W <= 0:
        raise ValueError("invalid width %r (must be > 0)" % W)
    ml = o['max_lines']; ph = o['placeholder']
    init = o['initial_indent']; sub = o['subsequent_indent']
    if ml is not None:
        indent = sub if ml > 1 else init
        if len(indent) + len(ph.lstrip()) > W:
            raise ValueError("placeholder too large for max width")
    drop = o['drop_whitespace']
    lines = []
    chunks.reverse()
    while chunks:
        cur = []; cl = 0
        indent = sub if lines else init
        w = W - len(indent)
        if drop and chunks[-1].strip() == '' and lines:
            del chunks[-1]
        while chunks:
            l = len(chunks[-1])
            if cl + l <= w:
                cur.append(chunks.pop()); cl += l
            else:
                break
        if chunks and len(chunks[-1]) > w:
            sl = 1 if w < 1 else w - cl
            if o['break_long_words']:
                end = sl
                chunk = chunks[-1]
                if o['break_on_hyphens'] and len(chunk) > sl:
                    h = chunk.rfind('-', 0, sl)
                    if h > 0 and any(c != '-' for c in chunk[:h]):
                        end = h + 1
                cur.append(chunk[:end]); chunks[-1] = chunk[end:]
            elif not cur:
                cur.append(chunks.pop())
            cl = sum(map(len, cur))
        if drop and cur and cur[-1].strip() == '':
            cl -= len(cur[-1]); del cur[-1]
        if cur:
            if (ml is None or len(lines) + 1 < ml or
                    ((not chunks or drop and len(chunks) == 1 and not chunks[0].strip()) and cl <= w)):
                lines.append(indent + ''.join(cur))
            else:
                while cur:
                    if cur[-1].strip() and cl + len(ph) <= w:
                        cur.append(ph)
                        lines.append(indent + ''.join(cur))
                        break
                    cl -= len(cur[-1]); del cur[-1]
                else:
                    if lines:
                        prev = lines[-1].rstrip()
                        if len(prev) + len(ph) <= W:
                            lines[-1] = prev + ph
                            break
                    lines.append(indent + ph.lstrip())
                break
    return lines
